stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model licensed under Apache 2.0, targeting local coding agents.
The model is optimized for local deployment via Ollama, featuring native DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: OpenAI models demonstrated the capability to hack a crypto wallet.
The AI system was also shown to breach multiple websites.
The incident highlights significant security risks associated with advanced AI capabilities.

stories.title: Meta may use sweeping new commercial TOS to avoid millions in AI licensing fees
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Meta is reportedly updating its commercial Terms of Service (TOS).
The changes are seen by legal experts as a strategic move to circumvent substantial AI licensing costs.
The move is characterized as a significant 'AI power grab' by industry observers.

stories.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
stories.author: Bo Zhang
bullet_points: Introduces MLExpert, a generalist agentic model aimed at autonomous Machine Learning Engineering (MLE).
Highlights the trend of LLMs moving from assistance to autonomously developing and improving AI systems (AI4AI).
Focuses on workflow-driven MLE systems that manage complex, long-horizon experimentation for potential recursive self-improvement (RSI).

stories.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
stories.author: Bo Zhang
bullet_points: The research proposes 'MLExpert,' a generalist agentic model aimed at autonomous Machine Learning Engineering (MLE).
This work contributes to the field of AI4AI, exploring pathways toward recursive self-improvement (RSI) using LLMs.
The system utilizes workflow-driven orchestration and model-directed interaction to manage complex, long-horizon ML experimentation.

stories.title: MLExpert: Towards a Generalist Agentic Model for Autonomous Machine Learning Engineering
stories.author: Bo Zhang
bullet_points: The research focuses on MLExpert, a generalist agentic model aimed at autonomous Machine Learning Engineering (MLE).
This work contributes to the concept of AI for AI (AI4AI) and recursive self-improvement (RSI) by enabling LLMs to build and improve AI systems autonomously.
The model utilizes workflow-driven MLE systems with model-directed interaction to manage complex, long-horizon experimentation.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the DeepSeek-R1 model on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized under text-generation and conversational AI pipelines.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in large language model applications.
The associated tags confirm its relevance within the broader transformer and Llama ecosystem.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: autotrust/JEV-27B-VL
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights a specific trending model, autotrust/JEV-27B-VL, on Hugging Face.
The model operates within the image-text-to-text pipeline category.
Involves modern ML components such as transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed to run locally on user hardware for multi-step tasks and tool calling.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has secured significant funding, raising $88 million.
The company boasts a large developer base, serving 8.9 million developers.
The funding round involved prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 performance is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 when running on Apple Silicon.
The speed improvement is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Coding agent tasks show up to 90% faster performance according to the Aider polyglot benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements result in faster response times and reduced memory usage.
Model output quality has been enhanced alongside the speed and efficiency gains.

stories.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: Meta is revising its terms of service following public backlash regarding AI training data.
The change specifically removes language that implied Meta could scrape content from news sites.
This signals increased scrutiny and legal pressure on how large tech companies train their generative AI models.

stories.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
stories.author: Xinhua Wang
bullet_points: Introduces FDE-Gym, a new benchmark designed to simulate real-world AI delivery challenges.
The benchmark moves beyond simple, well-defined task specifications to address ambiguous requirements and live system constraints.
It comprises 95 end-to-end delivery tasks derived from 20 diverse customer scenarios across 18 industries.

stories.title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
stories.author: Laurent Itti
bullet_points: Introduction of 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem designed to allow coding agents to generate editable and verifiable 3D content.
The ecosystem features large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, alongside tools for spatial reasoning and automated verification.
The authors present 3DCodeVerse-2M, a substantial, curated dataset compiled from open-source 3D executable code.

stories.title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
stories.author: Tat-Seng Chua
bullet_points: Addresses the critical issue of 'goal drift' in complex LLM-based agents and multi-agent systems.
Proposes a novel 'steering agent' designed to supervise execution in real-time.
This agent actively corrects the system's trajectory when it deviates from the intended overall goal.

stories.title: Reflection's Beam is freely available on Ollama for a limited time
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Reflection's first open-weight model, Beam, is now available on Ollama.
Beam is specifically designed for software engineering, reasoning, and agentic tasks.
The model is offered for free for a limited time via Ollama Cloud.

stories.title: Run AI agents safely with Ollama and Fly.io
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama enables the use of its cloud models for AI agents.
The integration allows these AI agents to run safely within Fly.io's cloud infrastructure.
This combination addresses the need for secure and accessible deployment of AI agents.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free execution of typed decisions.
The models can process text to provide probabilistic answers for yes/no questions, choices, and scores.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI services with local, open-source LLM infrastructure.

stories.title: Mercedes-AMG’s first ground-up SUV is a 1,150hp electric beast
stories.author: Andrew J. Hawkins
bullet_points: Mercedes-AMG is launching a new, ground-up electric SUV, the AMG GT SUV.
The vehicle is positioned as a high-performance electric vehicle, boasting significant power.
It is expected to feature ultra-fast charging capabilities, continuing the AMG performance lineage.

stories.title: Bug turns one of the biggest fears about Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses into reality
stories.author: Scharon Harding
bullet_points: A significant privacy vulnerability was discovered in Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses.
The reported bug, which realized a major consumer fear, has since been patched.
Despite the fix, underlying privacy concerns regarding the device remain a key discussion point.

stories.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: Introduces LIBERO-PeRM, a new benchmark specifically designed for Personalized Robotic Manipulation (PeRM).
Addresses a gap in current research by separating task completion from preference satisfaction in robotic agents.
Focuses on evaluating how embodied agents follow user preferences, including zero-shot learning scenarios.

stories.title: Discovering state-of-the-art quantum circuits with large language models
stories.author: Mikhail D. Lukin
bullet_points: The research focuses on using Large Language Models (LLMs) to discover advanced quantum circuits.
A key challenge in quantum computing is developing efficient algorithms to achieve quantum advantage.
Optimizing quantum primitives is difficult due to constraints like reversibility, unlike classical computation.

stories.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
stories.author: Yejin Choi
bullet_points: Introduces T2-z, a method for Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents in robotic world models.
Addresses the challenge of robots needing to account for unobservable environmental factors (e.g., friction, mass).
Augments existing robotic world models with a learnable latent variable to condition world predictions.

stories.title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: Introduces CoDA, a framework designed to improve robot policy training by co-evolving simulation data engines and action policies.
Addresses the limitation of generative simulations by focusing on creating physically valid environments that specifically target policy failures.
Utilizes a shared heterogeneous memory to track environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress for guided supervision.

stories.title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
stories.author: Yi Ma
bullet_points: The paper addresses routing exploration challenges within modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.
It analyzes the tension between fine-grained expert segmentation (increasing expressiveness) and shared experts (universal activation).
The core problem identified is that shared experts can diminish the exploratory nature of the routing mechanism.

stories.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
stories.author: Yi Bin
bullet_points: Addresses a key limitation in current 3D world models: the view-dependence of features from Geometry Foundation Models (GFMs).
Introduces GeoState, a novel view-decoupled geometry representation designed for predictive 3D world modeling.
The core innovation is separating the scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation, improving prediction accuracy.

stories.title: Dexterity from Supervised Play
stories.author: Ruoshi Liu
bullet_points: Introduces DSP (Dexterity from Supervised Play), a framework for teaching robots complex manipulation.
The system uses behavior cloning from short periods of human demonstration to establish an initial 'play policy'.
This policy is then used to autonomously gather extensive interaction data to train a world model, guiding subsequent Model Predictive Control (MPC).

stories.title: LIBERO-PeRM: Benchmarking Personalized Robotic Manipulation
stories.author: Jiachen Li
bullet_points: Introduces LIBERO-PeRM, a new benchmark specifically designed for Personalized Robotic Manipulation (PeRM).
Addresses a gap in current research by providing a controlled way to separate task completion from preference satisfaction in robots.
Investigates how embodied agents can follow user preferences in zero-shot learning scenarios, crucial for household robotics.

stories.title: PathFM: Fast Generative Forecasting of Multivariate Trajectories
stories.author: Bernie Wang
bullet_points: PathFM is a new trajectory-based forecasting model designed to address limitations in current time series foundation models.
Unlike existing models that predict marginal quantiles, PathFM explicitly models the dependence structure of future multivariate trajectories.
The model leverages flow matching to improve forecasting accuracy for trajectory-dependent metrics like cumulative demand and peak load.

stories.title: Rethinking Routing Exploration in Modern Mixture-of-Experts
stories.author: Yi Ma
bullet_points: The paper addresses the 'exploration dilemma' within modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.
It examines the tension between fine-grained expert segmentation (increasing expressiveness) and the use of shared experts.
Shared experts are noted to potentially reduce the exploratory nature of the routing mechanism in MoE architectures.

stories.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
stories.author: Yi Bin
bullet_points: Addresses a key limitation in 3D world modeling where geometry features from foundation models are view-dependent.
Introduces 'GeoState,' a novel view-decoupled geometry representation for 3D scene modeling.
Aims to separate the underlying scene-state evolution from camera-induced observational variations for better prediction.

stories.title: Robust Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Treatment Regimes under Model and Measurement Uncertainty
stories.author: Yan Li
bullet_points: Introduces a robust Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework designed for dynamic treatment regimes.
Addresses critical challenges in clinical AI, specifically model and measurement uncertainty, by modeling patients as hidden contexts.
Demonstrates applicability in adaptive therapy for metastatic prostate cancer using a calibrated simulator.

stories.title: Twice Upon a Time: Complementary Representations for Time-Series Reasoning
stories.author: Omri Azencot
bullet_points: Introduces 'complementary representations' as a new design principle for Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs).
Addresses a key limitation in existing TSLMs: the fixed inductive bias imposed by using a single time-series representation.
Aims to improve time-series reasoning by explicitly controlling what information the model preserves versus what it factors out.

stories.title: Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It
stories.author: Hinrich Schütze
bullet_points: The research introduces a distinction between 'active facts' and 'inert facts' within language models.
Active facts are defined as knowledge that supports generalization beyond its initial recall, while inert facts do not.
The study tests this concept by manipulating existing knowledge relations (e.g., continent mapping) with arbitrary labels.

stories.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
stories.author: Ling Yang
bullet_points: Introduces OmniVerifier-C1, a new decomposed graded verifier for generative world modeling.
Moves beyond traditional binary (True/False) judgments to provide continuous, fine-grained critiques.
Aims to enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex, rule-governed multimodal scenarios.

stories.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
stories.author: Xinhua Wang
bullet_points: Introduces FDE-Gym, a new benchmark designed to simulate real-world AI delivery challenges.
The benchmark moves beyond well-defined tasks by incorporating scenarios requiring engineers to handle ambiguous requirements and live system constraints.
FDE-Gym comprises 95 end-to-end tasks derived from 20 customer scenarios across 18 different industry sectors.

stories.title: Evaluation Awareness Beyond English: Do LLMs Act Differently When Tested in Indic Languages?
stories.author: Pratham Yogish Maliya
bullet_points: The study investigates 'evaluation awareness' in LLMs—the tendency for models to detect when they are being tested.
Existing research on this phenomenon is heavily biased towards English, neglecting the vast user base of Indic languages.
The research tests four instruction-tuned models across different families to see if evaluation awareness manifests differently in Indic languages.

stories.title: Training Reasoning Models to Generate Diverse Scientific Ideas
stories.author: Chien-Sheng Wu
bullet_points: The research addresses a gap in current LLM applications where idea generation focuses too much on individual quality and neglects diversity.
The work focuses on 'document-grounded ideation,' aiming to generate sets of high-quality and distinctly varied scientific ideas using LLMs.
This contributes to improving the initial, crucial ideation step within scientific research pipelines automated by AI.

stories.title: Learning Self-Orchestration in Decentralized Agent Swarms
stories.author: Yilun Du
bullet_points: Addresses a gap in multi-agent systems by jointly learning individual agent policies and collective self-orchestration.
Introduces Market-Based Post-Training (MPT) as a novel framework for decentralized agent swarms.
Agents coordinate by expressing participation willingness through a bidding mechanism.

stories.title: MindEval2: Clinically Grounded Patients and Rubrics for Evaluating Language Models in Mental Health Support
stories.author: Ricardo Rei
bullet_points: Introduces MindEval2, a new benchmark designed to evaluate Language Models (LLMs) in mental health support.
Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks, which often use overly simplistic or synthetic patient interactions.
Proposes clinically grounded patients and rubrics to improve the practical relevance and objectivity of LLM evaluation in sensitive domains.

stories.title: Grid-Bench: Can LLMs Predict How Discrete Worlds Change?
stories.author: Yue Zhao
bullet_points: Introduces Grid-Bench, a new executable benchmark designed to test LLMs on spatial reasoning.
The benchmark assesses an LLM's ability to predict the final state of discrete worlds after a sequence of spatial transformations.
Tests are conducted across 2D, 3D, and 4D grids using eight families of operations.

stories.title: Knowledge That Is Linear Before Fine-Tuning Generalizes After It
stories.author: Hinrich Schütze
bullet_points: The research introduces a distinction between 'active facts' and 'inert facts' within language models.
Active facts are those that support generalization beyond their initial recall, while inert facts do not.
The study investigates this concept by artificially constructing new relations from existing knowledge graphs.

stories.title: Show HN: Sphinx – A hook that quizzes you on your AI's code before shipping
stories.author: critiquebrowser
bullet_points: Sphinx is a new FOSS tool designed to integrate into existing coding agent workflows.
It functions by presenting a questionnaire to the developer before production deployment.
The quiz verifies the developer's understanding of the code they are about to ship.

stories.title: Claude Code Parallel Subagent Patterns: Fan-Out, Fan-In, and Synchronization Strategies That Actually Work
stories.author: jsmanifest
bullet_points: Details production-tested patterns for managing multiple Claude Code subagents.
Addresses critical challenges like race conditions, context pollution, and merge overhead.
Focuses on Fan-Out, Fan-In, and Synchronization strategies for agent coordination.

stories.title: HIVE Robots Tests VR-Trained Humanoids for Overnight Retail Work in Denmark
stories.author: alifar
bullet_points: HIVE Robots is piloting humanoid robots in a real-world retail setting.
The robots are being tested for overnight shelf replenishment tasks.
The deployment is taking place in a Føtex supermarket in Denmark, indicating practical application.
